q: How do we count printed brochures and catalogues in Scope 3?
title: Printed brochures and catalogues
short: They are purchased goods, Scope 3 Category 1. Use the paper weight and a paper factor per kg, plus the printer's energy if it shares a figure. Without weights, use the printing bill with a spend-based factor and label it as an estimate. Distribution by courier is transport.
audience: Marketing teams and exporters printing catalogues

ol: Pages × paper GSM × sheet area gives kg per copy.
Multiply by the paper factor; add inks and binding if known.

p: Copies printed and later pulped were still produced, so count everything printed.

senseible: Senseible keeps purchase invoices on the Scope 3 trail with the category, method and factor source on every line, so spend-based estimates are labelled as estimates and can be replaced with supplier data later.
